commit: the verbatim commit the record stamps, read from the field commit_stamp names; scripts/step1_b300_summary.py refuses a record whose stamp is not this. A gate record whose commit_stamp is null stamps no commit: its commit is the one the gate summary of the same run stamps for every arm, which the script checks instead.
gzip: gzip -9 -n of the raw file (no name or time in the header). sha256_raw and bytes_raw are of the decompressed bytes, sha256_gz and bytes_gz of the file here.
not_a_row: Exploratory records, not harness rows. scripts/step1_b300_summary.py derives its figures from these files and those of step1-a6000-c8-2026-09-26/ and nothing else; see rows/exploratory/README.md.
not_copied: From the captures' run directory: compare_captures.py's reports (frozen-eager.json, frozen-graphs.json, places-eager-report.json), which scripts/step1_b300_summary.py derives again from the captures, and the text logs. From the overload runs' directories (concurrency 128 and 64): the probe's text logs and the server logs. From the gate: each arm's arm.json and server-environ.json, which hold the server process's whole environment (host names, network addresses, account names and paths outside any placeholder) and are not committed; the facts the summary reads from an arm are in its record-summary.json, smoke-check.json and serve-spec.json, copied here. Also not copied: the arms' admission, readyz, monitor and smoke logs, and the rest of the preflight.
original: the file name the tool wrote, relative to the step-1 output directory of the machine that ran it

scrubbed: scripts/scrub_record_paths.py replaced the absolute paths each record's tool stamped by a placeholder: <checkout>, the verbatim checkout the tool and the server ran from; <home>, the home directory of the user who ran them; <step1-out>, the directory the step-1 tools wrote their records and logs to; <venv>, the Python virtual environment they ran in; <workdir>, the directory that held the checkout, the environment, the model cache, the corpus and the outputs, where no narrower placeholder applies. A record that names another here by sha256 names the scrubbed one. sha256_as_written and bytes_as_written are the record as its tool wrote it; scrub says what was replaced. A record without them held no path and is as written.
what: The raw records of step 1 on one NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC (2026-09-26, and the retest at concurrency 64 on 2026-09-27): server captures at 26eaebb (fixed padding eager and on the CUDA-graph path at concurrency 32 and 8, ragged twice at 32, and the places), an overload test at ba20c49 (one complete ragged run at concurrency 128 and the refused second run), a retest at concurrency 64 at ba20c49 (a failed first attempt at the ragged run; then, on another server process, two complete ragged runs one after the other; then, on a third, the fixed run, refused), and the invariance runbook at ba20c49 (four arms), each gzipped whole: decompressing a file gives the record its tool wrote, with only its machine paths replaced (see scrubbed).
